LLM_PROVIDER.description: Which AI company runs the interviews: type `openai`, `gemini` or `claude`. Then paste the matching API key below.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Only needed if LLM_PROVIDER is `openai`. Create a key at [platform.openai.com/api-keys](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Otherwise type `none`.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Only needed if LLM_PROVIDER is `gemini`. Create a key at [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Otherwise type `none`.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Only needed if LLM_PROVIDER is `claude`. Create a key at [console.anthropic.com/settings/keys](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Otherwise type `none`.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional. Any long random text. Type `none` to let the app derive one from your API key.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional. A password for downloading a CSV backup of all interviews at `/export?password=...`. Type `none` to turn the download off.

DB.description: Optional backup copy of every interview. Keep the suggested name.
